'''Tommy Minton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 1999 Boca Raton tournament]] on 5 September 1999 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base/Numbers]], according to Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d34">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-boca-raton-florida-9-5-99d34/ boca-raton-florida-9-5-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 10 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-boca-raton-florida-9-5-99d34/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
